rubric.search_query:
Find candidates for this role:
Community support role for a social-events app, handling user issues, documenting bugs, identifying recurring problems, and sharing feedback with product and engineering teams.
Mandatory professional qualifications:
- 2+ years of experience in customer support, community support, or user-facing operations.
Preferred, not mandatory:
- Experience at a consumer social app, ticketing platform, or events company.
- Experience working with product/engineering teams and writing strong bug reports.
Work location and geographic eligibility:
Location: New York metropolitan area. Hybrid work is based in this area, and candidates must currently be located in it. Specific cities and metropolitan areas also include any location within about 100 miles (160 km) of them; states, countries, and regions require a location inside them.
